question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing goalkeeper, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing left winger, and Eve is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Alice and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) goalkeeper
(B) right winger
(C) cheerleader
(D) left winger
(E) striker
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (goalkeeper, right winger, cheerleader, left winger, striker)
After Eve and Claire swap: (goalkeeper, right winger, striker, left winger, cheerleader)
After Claire and Eve swap: (goalkeeper, right winger, cheerleader, left winger, striker)
After Bob and Eve swap: (goalkeeper, striker, cheerleader, left winger, right winger)
After Claire and Alice swap: (cheerleader, striker, goalkeeper, left winger, right winger)
After Alice and Bob swap: (striker, cheerleader, goalkeeper, left winger, right winger)
Bob is playing cheerleader, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
